hypothesis: Conditioning on actually executed local actions can reverse the assignment-level final-outcome comparison for a fallback-bearing route; a complete assignment/exposure ledger detects the selection and prevents promoting it.
scope: Deterministic synthetic/method-only CPU T0. No repo runtime, model, GUI, game, input, external data, GPU or human outcome.
assignment_unit: one synthetic task row; each policy is evaluated on the same four named task strata as an explicitly constructed paired table; this is not randomized real-world evidence or a causal estimate
primary_estimand: all-assigned task-row mean final success and mean total end-to-end time for the deployable policy, including fallback rows and costs
secondary_estimand: descriptive A/local-exposure-only row subset; never causal and never substituted for the primary denominator
required_mutations: relabel A fallback rows as local exposure
set A fallback total time to zero
decision: PASS_METHOD_SCOPED only if both frozen fixtures produce exact expected aggregates/flow, candidate and independent oracle agree, denominator/path/time mutations are all rejected, and raw-input digest and raw-output audit pass; otherwise FAIL_T0_CONTRACT or HOLD_INTEGRITY.
causal_boundary: A PASS demonstrates a selection/denominator failure mode in this authored finite fixture only. It is neither randomization, causal inference, IV/complier identification, nor evidence that an existing repository comparison is biased.
execution_plan: Freeze fixture and decision before coding; publish exact candidate/oracle/auditor source hashes before execution; run each exactly once on CPU; preserve stdout/exit receipts; auditor runs once after candidate exit 0. Host-only because this deterministic four-row analytic T0 has no environment dependency and no shared container slot is assigned.
